rationale: C08 plausibly supplied a concrete drafting template for the child. The two orders share the same ordered machinery: establishment and presidential designation of a commission, authorization to investigate and report findings and recommendations, authority to hold public hearings and hear witnesses, nearly verbatim federal-agency cooperation language, financing from the Emergency Fund with the same statutory exceptions, presidentially fixed compensation, and dissolution thirty days after the final report. This extensive combination of literal language and parallel operative structure is materially stronger than generic commission boilerplate. C13 and C12 contain similarly close commission frameworks, but C08 most closely matches the child's overall sequence and wording.

shared_material.child_excerpt: There is hereby established a Presidential commission ... The commission shall consist of fifteen members to be designated by the President
shared_material.parent_excerpt: There is hereby established a Commission which shall be known as the President's Commission on Veterans' Pensions ... all of whom shall be designated by the President.
shared_material.explanation: Both begin by establishing a presidential commission and prescribing its presidentially designated membership.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The commission is authorized and directed to investigate and to inquire into the issues ... making a report to the President, including its findings and recommendations
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Commission is authorized and directed to make a comprehensive survey and appraisal ... and it shall make recommendations to the President
shared_material.explanation: The operative mandate uses closely parallel investigation-and-recommendation machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: the commission is authorized to hold such public hearings and to hear such witnesses as it may deem appropriate
shared_material.parent_excerpt: the Commission may ... hold such public hearings and hear such witnesses as it may deem appropriate
shared_material.explanation: This hearing authority is almost verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the commission in its work and to furnish the commission with such information and assistance, not inconsistent with law, as it may require
shared_material.parent_excerpt: All executive departments and agencies of the Federal Government are authorized and directed to cooperate with the Commission in its work and to furnish the Commission such information and assistance, not inconsistent with law, as it may require
shared_material.explanation: The cooperation clause is essentially verbatim.

shared_material.child_excerpt: expenditures of the commission may be paid out of an allotment made by the President from the appropriation ... 'Emergency Fund for the President-National Defense' ... without regard to ... section 3681 ... section 9 of the act of March 4, 1909 ... and ... other provisions of law as the President may hereafter specify
shared_material.parent_excerpt: expenditures of the Commission shall be paid out of an allotment made by the President from the appropriation entitled 'Emergency Fund for the President—National Defense' ... without regard to ... section 3681 ... section 9 of the act of March 4, 1909 ... and such other laws as the President may hereafter specify
shared_material.explanation: The child reuses the same distinctive funding source and tripartite statutory-exception formula.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The commission shall cease to exist thirty days after the rendition of Its final report to the President.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Commission shall cease to exist 30 days after making its final report to the President.
shared_material.explanation: The termination mechanism and timing are substantively identical.
